cross_mappings.name: Legal accountability
cross_mappings.description: Determining who is responsible for an AI model is challenging without good documentation and governance processes. The use of synthetic data in model development adds further complexity, since the lack of standardized frameworks for recording synthetic data design choices and verification steps makes accountability harder to establish.
